map.MCH 与 MCHC 哪个更敏感？: Which Is More Sensitive, MCH or MCHC?
map.MCHC 降低出现较晚但特异性较好；MCH 降低较早出现。两者同时降低、MCV: A drop in MCHC appears later but is more specific; a drop in MCH appears earlier. When both fall and MCV is also low, the judgment of hypochromic microcytic anemia is more reliable. This tool only computes indices; confirmation requires iron metabolism and other tests.
map.MCV 正常就排除缺铁吗？: Does a Normal MCV Rule Out Iron Deficiency?
map.→ 打开贫血 MCV/MCH/MCHC 形态分类器工具: -> Open the Anemia MCV/MCH/MCHC Morphology Classifier tool
map.不一定。早期缺铁或合并慢性病贫血时 MCV 可仍在正常范围（正细胞性），此时 R: Not necessarily. In early iron deficiency or anemia of chronic disease, MCV may still be within the normal range (normocytic); at this stage a rise in RDW (anisocytosis) is often an earlier signal, and it should be read together with iron metabolism indices.

map.：例（HGB=85 g/L、RBC=3.5×10¹²/L、HCT=27%）：MC: : Example (HGB=85 g/L, RBC=3.5×10¹²/L, HCT=27%): MCV=27×10/3.5=77.1 fL (↓ microcytic), MCH=85/3.5=24.3 pg (↓), MCHC=85×100/27=314.8 g/L (↓). All three are low, so this is microcytic hypochromic anemia; the most common cause is iron deficiency anemia, and serum iron, ferritin, and total iron binding capacity should be checked to confirm.
map.：红细胞指数（标准公式）：MCV(fL)=HCT(%)×10/RBC(×10¹²: : Red cell indices (standard formulas): MCV(fL)=HCT(%)×10/RBC(×10¹²/L); MCH(pg)=HGB(g/L)/RBC(×10¹²/L); MCHC(g/L)=HGB(g/L)×100/HCT(%). Reference ranges: MCV 80–100 fL, MCH 27–34 pg, MCHC 320–360 g/L. Morphological classification: MCV<80 is microcytic and >100 macrocytic; reduced MCH/MCHC indicates hypochromia.
